newsitem.title: USA: Entergy Arkansas nuke goes to refueling early.
newsitem.headline: Entergy Arkansas nuke goes to refueling early.

text.p: Entergy Corp's 836 megawatt Arkansas nuclear power unit 1 will go into a 30-day scheduled refueling outage earlier than expected after an unexpected shutdown Thursday, a company spokeswoman said.
The unit, located at Russellville, Ark., was scheduled to begin the refueling outage on September 16, but will now go into the 30-day outage early, spokeswoman Diane Park said Friday.
The unit was shut down Thursday due to a problem with an electrical relay leading to two reactor coolant pumps, spokeswoman Diane Park said Friday.
"Our next refueling outage was planned for Monday, but we will now go into that early," Park said.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
